description: CUR-LIFE, variant: does closing a Clone inside an explicit transaction undo work? Each case on its own row of T: (1) BeginTrans, edit and Update N of ID 1, Clone, close the clone, Rollback; (2) BeginTrans, Edit N of ID 2 left pending, Clone, close clone, read EditMode, Update, CommitTrans; (3) BeginTrans, Update N of ID 3, Clone, close clone, CommitTrans; (4) no transaction, Update N of ID 4, Clone, close clone; Errors after each close; T is read at the end.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
